description: Query Loki logs with a LogQL expression over a time range.

datasourceUid.description: The uid of the Loki datasource to query through.

end.description: Optional end of the query time range, as accepted by the Loki query_range API.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of log lines to return (default 100, clamped to 1-5000).

query.description: The LogQL query expression selecting the log streams and lines to return.

start.description: Optional start of the query time range, as accepted by the Loki query_range API.

name: query_loki_logs
